text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan was drooping listlessly in the 
training gym.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... At this rate, my muscles won't 
reach peak condition at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I can't lift the bench press like I 
usually do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's chest press or leg press, 
whenever I increase the weight, I can't 
keep going at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... What on earth has happened to my 
body?

Running so many races in a row seems to 
have built up more fatigue than she even 
realizes. I might need to reconsider her 
upcoming race entries...
